notes.title: 20250203 Patch Description Bug Fix
notes.content:
Bug fix: 
1. Third and fourth world bugs that do not disable archive systems 
2. BUG that allows fishing to continue even after being killed by fish 
(Not) new content: 
1. Updated the obsolete case TYP and casino, which can be accessed from the computer in the first room where the game starts.
Did it update today? It seems like there's no change, it can only be said to be like a change. 
Overall, it means updating the content that cannot be continued. (Sad) 
That means two games that cannot be played and are both BUGs have been updated. 
Not recommended for playing, 
I tried it out and even found the invalid cases in the invalid cases, so I took it. 
I feel like I can't do these two anymore, but I don't want to throw them away directly. 
(That can't just be presented to players like this!) 
Anyway, thank you for seeing this. 
At present, I don't have much inspiration. Once I have it, I will update the game!

notes.title: 20231208 大型更新公告 新地图-乐园 现已上线
notes.content:
【New content】
Fourth World-Amusement Park
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44175669/354bf191d2e9fac675fd2185a4dc6d33fd6ad57c.png

All updates this time are free content


1. A new map filled with entertainment facilities!


2. To maintain the facilities of the mysterious amusement park, its functions will not be disclosed, so play on your own! (It's the same as not saying it!)


3. The partner system has been fixed and two roles that can be added!


 New partners 

Tia is a lively and cheerful girl who excels in magic and is not afraid of difficulties!


 New temporary partner 

Dracula's mysterious vampire can help you in special situations and add a unique storyline to it.


4. Fingertip Flame Free DLC has exploded, and Steam cannot upload mobile games. We may find a way to implement it elsewhere. Sorry.


5. There's nothing else, I wish all the friends who see here never die. Goodbye!


6. By the way, in case you can't find the entrance to the Fourth World, let me remind you that behind the underground boss of the Third World - Inheritance Fire,

Defeat the boss to qualify for entry!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44175669/0ce3cfdfc3dbaa8d3759f9003387c69c2e4f42f8.jpg

If you haven't reached the Third World yet, or if you're just experiencing this game for the first time, it's okay. I released the jump level,

You can directly launch the Fourth World in the beginner's tutorial! (Approximately)

notes.title: 20230903 Mainframe Flip Update Announcement - Fire of Inheritance
notes.content:
【New content】
Third World - Fire of Inheritance
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44175669/714492ff94766f07ba76a5f30372ff9e4e893440.png

1. A brand new map! But play on your own with more spoilers!


2. New weapons, armor, and props!


3. Several NPCs, several bosses, and bosses with both NPCs


4. New card updates from Second World - Dueling World

-Obtained through special means or synthesized

107 Bonfire regenerates health every turn and places a potion hose to fill your library
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44175669/68573caecb32cd7f1edec3a22696401c5f4e756c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44175669/170fecdd1f94de84e92ccbc2795187d37e354a0e.png
109 Bat 31 restores the summon's own health when attacking
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44175669/1e3de2b59da294a391f36dc4f98718e644d83404.png 
110 Quickly kill the opponent's summon during ground stab attacks
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44175669/b8afb627f6c3a0a36c11f2c125234aaea229d64e.png
111 Treasure Chest is just a harmless box for humans and animals, don't worry
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44175669/9be3b21351ef325b6c591508474cad6f1ada9e77.png
111-2

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44175669/202face0e24b5f034d7e6be224f57826e64fed71.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44175669/df6c213ec50238e752342e6296e514449ced685d.png

5. New talents


29 Counterattack Storm - There is a chance to give the opponent a counterattack when attacked

30 Fountain of Magic - Restores a certain amount of magic per turn or step of the battle

31 Double Blade Mighty General - Can equip both hands with the main weapon


Strengthened some talents, including/ruthless and ruthless/non combustible/combat focus/Shoubi Nanshan/magic talents/


6. Added empty glass bottles for lottery machine items

【New DLC】
Inheritance Fire - Fingertip Fire
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44175669/454e2ada5ad244b63e719e57268b40d932db0068.png

Free DLC, which will be launched later after I understand how to upload DLC,

Computer players don't have to worry about this DLC, which is the Android mobile version of 'Junk Game'.

Convenient for everyone to play without a computer, although I don't know why players who buy games in Steam need this


Additionally, there are some issues with this end. I don't know why only two of my three phones can be installed,

HUAWEI P9 Plus and OPPO R17 are both installed, but my Redmi k60 pro prompts that the version is too old to install

Perhaps some newer phones may fail to install, but I can only express my low technical skills. I'm sorry, they have been turned on.


Also, I apologize for not being able to create and test the Apple version of the game due to the lack of a fruit machine_(:з」∠)_
